correctness.rationale: Direct reconstruction from inclusion-exclusion: odd bases satisfy q-1 divisible by 2^{n+2}; all higher divided-difference terms have valuation >=2n+3; coefficients reduce by at most h. Even-base normalized contribution has valuation >=2^n-h-w, at least n+2 by hypothesis. The exact 2014 theorem gives valuation n+1 of the doubling reference; equality follows. The standalone checker independently confirmed 25 exact recurrence cases and 48 high-exponent modular cases; the proof, not the tests, covers all allowed quantifiers.
